<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Planning found (2026-11-04): pij-fleet's government root has no prd/ folder; AGENTS.md line 18 points at <government-root>/prd/base-prd.dd.json, which does not exist here. The register is in the legacy repo AI-Substrate/pij (PRIVATE), branch prime-governance, path .harness/government/prd/base-prd.dd.json: schema prd/requirements, 54 rows (36 unchecked, 10 checked, 4 shipped, 4 open), 113 KB, last changed 2026-09-07 (e05661c8). pij-fleet is PUBLIC. Rows cite private PR numbers, machine-local paths (/Users/...), scratch files and other projects (chainglass). pij/prd requires priority and done_when on every row; the source has neither. PRD number 002 is claimed for this plan by pm-001.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- pij's requirements live in docs/project/prds/ beside PRD 001, under the same schema.
- No requirement, state or receipt is lost in the move.
- Nothing private reaches the public repo.
- Everything that pointed at the old path points at the new one.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Re-deciding any requirement. Rows move as they are; amendments come later, through the PRD procedure (s13).
- Editing the legacy repo. Its prime commits the retirement pointer there.
